description: Defines an internal sealed class OldEnvironmentStatistics that implements IAppEnvironmentStatistics and IHostEnvironmentStatistics, providing environment statistics data such as CPU usage and memory usage, using an injected IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider.

classes.name: OldEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An obsolete internal sealed class providing environment statistics data based on an injected provider.

methods.name: CpuUsage
methods.description: Property returning the filtered CPU usage percentage.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: Property returning the filtered memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: AvailableMemory
methods.description: Property returning the filtered available memory in bytes.

methods.name: TotalPhysicalMemory
methods.description: Property returning the maximum available memory in bytes.
